name: Scarlet Spire
source:
Scarlet Jackson is a young computer analyst that is called one rainy evening to work on a main computer system in one of the oldest and most mysterious companies - Spire Corporation. Although at first Scarlet finds ways to explain occurring events, soon she will uncover that there are many secrets hidden behind glass walls of Spire, and she will be dragged further into strange events and take part in some of the most tense moments of her life.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/alleykatgames]Patreon[/url]]
